notes: The shared secret is NOT here — it is the long random SECRET PATH in the webhook URL. TradingView cannot be assumed to send custom headers, so the secret path is the primary auth; no secret goes in the body or query string.
X-TV-Token header is valid for manual local POST tests only. Real TradingView Stage 2 must authenticate by exact long random secret path unless custom header support is independently confirmed.
Placeholders use TradingView {{...}} syntax, substituted at fire time.
Items marked TO_VERIFY have not been confirmed against a live alert dialog; verify at execution before relying on them.
If TradingView does not support a placeholder, omit that field rather than sending a literal {{...}} (the receiver flags unresolved {{...}} as parse_status=UNRESOLVED_PLACEHOLDER).
